notes: Site type 'pools'. The entry says the ancient pools were destroyed by a new earth dike; an oval enclosure c. 35 m across with a hollow survives, 'perhaps a remnant of one of the pools' - treated as one of f1/f2, not a third pool. The two pools are from the Emergency Survey text quoted in the entry. No direction for either pool, so position none. Data block 'Cisterns: none' recorded as a C2 absence. No graves. No plan. Printed grid 1969/1638 is 100 m S of the unit point (per extraction note).
